title: OSI Hackathon Schema
description: Equilibrium solution data with physical properties, phases, named component solubility quantities, PubChem substances, and publication references.
$comment: Validates one EquilibriumSolution measurement state, without an EntryArchive data wrapper. Fields remain optional as in schema.archive.yaml. Numeric values use fixed declared storage units; fractions and mass ratios are dimensionless. Header prefactors and source units must be normalized before validation. The unit keyword preserves NOMAD storage units; JSON Schema validators do not convert units, derive missing measures, or run NOMAD normalizers. Amount quantities belong to individual phase components. Each phase and phase component has an optional substance described by PubChemPureSubstanceSection.

ArchiveSection.title: ArchiveSection
ArchiveSection.description: Base for archive sections with NOMAD normalization support.

m_def.description: Optional NOMAD section definition reference for selecting a concrete section type.

EntryData.title: EntryData
EntryData.description: Base for the data section of a NOMAD entry; adds no quantities.

BaseSection.title: BaseSection
BaseSection.description: Shared descriptive metadata for NOMAD sections.

datetime.description: Date and time associated with the section.

lab_id.description: Identifier unique within the laboratory producing the data.

description.description: Additional information not captured by the other fields.

ComponentBase.title: NOMAD Component
ComponentBase.description: Amounts and identifying information for a component in a mixture.

mass_fraction.description: Component mass divided by the mixture mass.

PureSubstanceSection.title: PureSubstanceSection
PureSubstanceSection.description: Chemical identity and molecular properties of a pure substance.

iupac_name.description: Systematic IUPAC name of the substance.

molecular_mass.description: Mass of a molecule with the most likely isotopic composition.

molar_mass.description: Mass per mole using the substance's isotopic composition.

monoisotopic_mass.description: Molecular mass calculated from the most abundant isotope of each element.

canonical_smile.description: Canonical SMILES representation of the structure.

PubChemPureSubstanceSection.title: PubChemPureSubstanceSection
PubChemPureSubstanceSection.description: Pure substance with PubChem compound identifiers and inherited chemical properties.
PubChemPureSubstanceSection.$comment: JSON Schema validation does not populate defaults or fetch PubChem data.

pub_chem_link.description: Link to the PubChem compound record.

PureSubstanceComponent.title: PureSubstanceComponent
PureSubstanceComponent.description: Mixture component linked to its pure-substance details.

substance_name.description: Substance name used within the containing mixture.

pure_substance.description: Chemical properties of the substance forming this component.

Component.title: Component
Component.description: Pure-substance component with amounts and PubChem substance details.

PublicationReference.title: PublicationReference
PublicationReference.description: Bibliographic details for a related publication or dataset.

DOI_number.description: DOI identifying the publication or dataset.

Amount.title: Amount
Amount.description: Named solubility and composition quantities for one component, normalized to the declared storage units. For a header 10^n q, divide the tabulated value by 10^n before unit conversion. Several measures may coexist; omitted measures are not derived.

mole_fraction.description: Component amount divided by total amount in its phase: x in liquids, y in gases, or x(s) in solids; dimensionless.

mass_fraction.description: Component mass divided by solution mass; dimensionless. Divide printed 100 w or g per 100 g solution by 100, g/kg solution by 1000, and mg/kg solution by 1000000.

molality.description: Solute amount per unit mass of solvent, in mol/kg solvent.

molar_concentration.description: Component amount per solution volume, in mol/m^3. Multiply mol/dm^3 or mol/L values by 1000 for storage.

mass_concentration.description: Component mass per solution volume, in kg/m^3; g/dm^3 and g/L have the same numerical value. Mass-per-mass forms use mass_fraction or solute_solvent_mass_ratio according to the stated denominator.

solute_solvent_mass_ratio.description: Solute mass divided by solvent mass; dimensionless. Divide g per 100 g solvent by 100, g/kg solvent by 1000, and mg/kg solvent by 1000000. The source must identify the solvent denominator.

bunsen_coefficient.description: Bunsen coefficient alpha: gas volume at the source's stated reference conditions (usually 273.15 K and 1 atm) divided by solvent volume at measurement conditions; dimensionless. Use bunsen_coefficient_per_pressure for a pressure-normalized result.

bunsen_coefficient_per_pressure.description: Bunsen reference-condition gas-volume/solvent-volume ratio divided by gas partial pressure, in Pa^-1. The source must specify the gas-volume reference conditions; convert inverse-atmosphere values to inverse pascals.

ostwald_coefficient.description: Ostwald coefficient L: gas volume at measurement temperature and pressure divided by solvent volume at measurement conditions; dimensionless. No value is derived from the Bunsen coefficient.

kuenen_coefficient.description: Kuenen coefficient S: gas volume at the source's stated reference conditions (usually 273.15 K and 1 atm) per solvent mass, in m^3/kg. Use kuenen_coefficient_per_pressure for a pressure-normalized result.

kuenen_coefficient_per_pressure.description: Kuenen reference-condition gas volume per solvent mass divided by gas partial pressure, in m^3/(kg Pa). The source must specify the gas-volume reference conditions; convert cm^3/(g atm) to the storage units.

henry_constant_p_over_x.description: Henry constant defined as gas partial pressure divided by liquid-phase mole fraction, p/x, in pascals. Select this convention from the source definition, not the symbol H alone.

henry_constant_p_over_c.description: Henry constant defined as gas partial pressure divided by liquid-phase molar concentration, p/c, in Pa m^3/mol. Convert reported atm m^3/mol or dm^3 mmHg/mol to these storage units.

henry_constant_c_gas_over_c_liquid.description: Henry constant defined as gas-phase molar concentration divided by liquid-phase molar concentration using matching concentration units; dimensionless. Select this convention from the source definition, not the symbol H alone.

partial_pressure.description: Component partial pressure associated with the reported gas-solubility measurements, in pascals. No pressure is assumed when omitted.

estimated_error_solubility.description: Reported estimated error in solubility, preserved as source text with its expression, units, symbols, and line breaks.

PhaseComponent.title: PhaseComponent
PhaseComponent.description: A component within a phase, with its substance and extracted amount.

name.description: Short descriptive name identifying this component within the phase.

density.description: Mass density of this component at the stated measurement conditions, in kg/m^3.

source_purity.description: Reported source, preparation, and purity of this material, preserved as text including units, symbols, percentages, and line breaks.

substance.description: Chemical identity and PubChem details of the substance forming this component.

amount.description: Reported solubility and composition quantities for this component, normalized to the declared storage units.

name.description: Short descriptive name identifying this phase within the equilibrium solution.

state_of_matter.description: Physical state of the phase, such as solid, liquid, or gas.

density.description: Bulk mass density of this phase at the stated measurement conditions, in kg/m^3.

salinity.description: Mass of dissolved salts divided by solution mass in this phase; dimensionless. Divide reported g/kg solution by 1000 for storage.

ph.description: pH of this phase at the stated measurement conditions; dimensionless.

substance.description: Chemical identity and PubChem details of the substance forming this phase.

components.description: Components forming this phase, with their substance details and solubility quantities.

temperature_initial.description: Initial temperature T_in of a dynamic measurement interval, in kelvin.

temperature_final.description: Final temperature T_fin of a dynamic measurement interval, in kelvin.

estimated_error_temperature.description: Reported estimated error in temperature, preserved as source text with its expression, units, symbols, and line breaks.

pressure.description: Total gas pressure over the solution, in pascals; component partial pressures are stored in PhaseComponent.amount.

measurement_methods.description: Methods used to measure the equilibrium properties of the solution.

mixing_methods.description: Methods used to mix the components when preparing the solution.
